mapper.select: SELECT b.jsondata as info,h.baseName as hospitalname, a.hid,a.deptname,a.doctorname,specialties,a.rid_long FROM doctor_basic a LEFT JOIN doctor_career b ON a.rid = b.rid LEFT JOIN hospital h ON a.hid = h.hid WHERE a.hid = #{search_hid} and is_active = 2 and a.data_version_id = #{search_data_version_id} ORDER BY a.deptname , a.doctorname LIMIT 5

SELECT b.jsondata as info,h.baseName as hospitalname, a.hid,a.deptname,a.doctorname,specialties,a.rid_long FROM doctor_basic a LEFT JOIN doctor_career b ON a.rid = b.rid LEFT JOIN hospital h ON a.hid = h.hid WHERE a.deptname = #{search_deptname} and a.doctorname = #{search_doctorname} and a.rid not in ( #{pass_rid} ) and a.data_version_id in ( 1,2 ) ORDER BY a.deptname , a.doctorname
